subject: Foundation MAP kickoff — ClearRiver evaluation & timeline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearriver.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Foundation MAP kickoff — ClearRiver evaluation & timeline
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. As discussed, I want to kick off a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) to align on success criteria, key stakeholders, and a target close timeline. I’ve attached a one-sheet MAP template with suggested milestones and owners — feel free to edit.

High-level goals we heard from the discovery:
- Evaluate Redwood inference for secure, on-prem inference for diagnostic NLP workflows
- Validate latency targets (95th percentile < 300ms for 512-token inference)
- Confirm integration approach for anonymized patient data and key security controls

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm champion + technical leads and attach tentative owners in the attached MAP (this email) — please add names in the first column.
2) Schedule a 45m kickoff with the ClearRiver working group this week to review milestones and success criteria.
3) Redwood will provide an evaluation plan (test corpus, baseline runbook, and short checklist) immediately after the kickoff.

Target timeline (draft):
- Kickoff: this week (Mar 24–25)
- Baseline evaluation: Apr 6–17
- Integration POC: Apr 20–May 8
- Decision / close: target May 15, 2026

Please reply with the people you want on the map and whether the timeline looks realistic. I’ve CC’d Marcus (your CSM) and Vivek (our sales lead) so they can join the kickoff if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering here.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference — production-grade inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP template — appreciate the structure. Quick answers from my side:

- I’ll be the product champion for this evaluation (Samantha Lee, Dir. of Product).
- Tech lead: Daniel Cho (platform/ML infra) — I’ve CC’d him.
- Security/compliance: Priya Rajan (privacy & security) — CC’d.

The timeline looks reasonable; May 15 for decision aligns with our procurement window.

I can do a kickoff Wed Mar 24 at 2:00pm ET or Thu Mar 25 in the morning. Please confirm a slot and we’ll add any additional stakeholders (procurement and legal may join later in the MAP for contract discussions).

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a temporary evaluation environment with network controls (VPC peering or IP-restricted endpoint) and a SOC2 report for our security folks to review? Priya will take the lead on that.

Samantha

Samantha — perfect, thanks for confirming owners. Wed Mar 24 at 2:00pm ET works for our team. I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute (45m).

Quick answers for Priya:
- Yes, we can spin up a constrained evaluation instance with IP allowlist and optional VPC peering for the POC. Marcus will own the env setup and provide the short network runbook.
- I’ve attached our SOC 2 summary and a link to the security factsheet in the calendar invite. If you need the full report we can initiate an NDA/procurement flow and get the auditor package to your security team.

Agenda for kickoff (draft, 45m):
- Introductions & success criteria (10m)
- Walk through the MAP template & timeline (10m)
- Evaluation plan: data, metrics, and runbook (12m)
- Roles, risks, and next steps (8m)
- Scheduling procurement/legal checkpoints and exec touchpoints (5m)

Action items I’ll take after kickoff: populate the shared MAP with milestones + due dates, deliver the evaluation runbook, and provision the evaluation instance.

See you Wed — calendar invite sent.

Thanks,
Olga
